title: 月薪8万招人，一群FDE却接不到单｜风向
content: Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) command high salaries, yet many struggle to secure work. While tech giants and startups aggressively recruit for these AI-focused roles, independent FDEs face significant hurdles in client acquisition and project delivery. Success requires strong communication skills and the ability to translate business needs into working systems. The role involves on-site problem-solving, with significant variance in pay based on project scale and location.
